opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grant

deadlines.raw: 1st day of February, April, June, August, October and December (bi-monthly)

amount.raw: Scheme A up to £200; Scheme B up to £500 (up to £750 for Adelphi Genetics Forum co-sponsored award); Scheme C up to £300

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society junior scientist members: Scheme A open to undergraduate, Master's and PhD student members and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva; Schemes B & C open to PhD student and postdoctoral members within six years of PhD viva. Applicants must present a poster or talk at the conference and supervisors must be current members.
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at genetics conferences, with three streams: (A) Genetics Society/SIG meetings, (B) non-Genetics Society meetings, and (C) virtual conferences.

opportunities.title: Training Grant

deadlines.raw: Quarterly, midnight on 15th February, May, August and November

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or attending a course held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year. Supervisors must be members.
opportunities.summary: Grants to enable members to attend formal short training courses, or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant

deadlines.raw: Quarterly, midnight on 1st February, May, August, November

opportunities.eligibility_summary: All Genetics Society members studying or working in the UK, or intending to carry out fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be members for at least one year. Supervisors must be members.
opportunities.summary: Funded by income from the journal Heredity, supports travel and accommodation costs associated with field-based genetic research projects whose results would typically be suitable for publication in Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant

deadlines.raw: Two deadlines per year (1st March and 1st October)

opportunities.summary: Supports public engagement activities related to genetics, delivered in person or virtually, covering eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: One-off Meeting Grant

amount.raw: Specific lecture a few hundred pounds; a session up to about £1,000; major sponsorship levels between £1,000 and £2,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic-themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, towards the organisation of a meeting (not attendance). Members may apply at any time of the year.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group (SIG) Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Genetics Society members. Meetings should be based in, or have strong links with, the UK.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of research meetings on particular themes for genetics research communities wishing to run regular series of meetings. Applications to become a new Special Interest Group should be submitted at least three months before the first meeting.

opportunities.title: Carer's Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any Genetics Society member, regardless of age of the person they are caring for. Priority given to early-career scientists and according to need.
opportunities.summary: Support (up to £60/day) to enable members with caring responsibilities to attend Society meetings or events, applied for prior to the meeting and competitive.
